observations.description: Firewall with forward proxy and UTM enabled is sending TLS probe with forward proxy IP instead of real server IP.
Local-in policy session will not update after policy changes.
Firewall is using the wrong NAT IP address to send out traffic after removing the VIP and its associated policy.
The packet dropped counter is not incremented for per-ip-shaper with max-concurrent-session as the only criterion and offload disabled on the firewall policy.

On the Network > Interfaces page, users cannot modify the TFTP server setting. A warning with the message This option may not function correctly. It is already configured using the CLI attribute: tftp-server. appears beside the DHCP Options entry.

On the Network > SD-WAN page, the volume sent/received displayed in the charts does not match the values provided from the REST API when the RX and TX values of diagnose sys sdwan intf-sla-log exceed 232-1.
Local-in policy with ha-mgmt-intf-only enabled is not installed properly.
Duplicate logs are created by both primary and secondary devices for IPsec VPN.
If the interface name is a number, an error occurs when that number is used as an hbdev priority.
IPS signatures not working with VIP in proxy mode.
Flow mode web filter ovrd crashes and socket leaks in IPS daemon.
Each time an AV database update occurs (scheduled or manually triggered), the IPS engine restarts on the SLBC secondary blade.
The IPS sessions count is higher than system sessions, which causes the FortiGate to enter conserve mode.
Each time an AV database update occurs (scheduled or manual), the IPS engine restarts on the SLBC secondary blade. This stops UTM analysis for sessions affected by that blade.
Traffic is failing on dialup VPN IKEv2 with EAP authentication.
IPsec server with NP offloading drops packets with an invalid SPI during rekey.
IPsec server with NP offloading drops packets with an invalid SPI during rekey.
Logs are missing on FortiGate Cloud from the FortiGate.
WAD may encounter memory corruption issue if the resources allocated by FTS are not cleaned up properly.

WAD memory leak is caused by missing a close event. The WAD receives a close event from TCP when the SSL port is blocked by the up application layer. If the SSL port input buffer does not have any data, then the close event will get ignored even if the application layer turns off blocking and the SSL port will leak.
WAD crashes at wad_client_cert_req_act_get when SSL layer configuration is cleaned up after policy matching.
WAD crash occurs that is related to virtual server traffic.
Dynamic address resolution is lost when SDN connector sends sync.callback command to the FortiGate.
FortiGate firewall dynamic address resolution lost when SDN connector updates its cache.
SSL VPN firewall policy creation via CLI does not require setting user identity.
If there are no users or groups in an SSL VPN policy, the SSL VPN daemon may crash when an FQDN is a destination address in the firewall policy.
Unable to access SSL VPN bookmark in web mode.
FortiGate loses FortiSwitch management access due to excessive configuration pushes.
HTTPSD signal 6 crash in cases of long application lists that are greater or equal to the maximum size of 16.
FG-80E terminates the firewall session abruptly when the end-users download large files.
A session clash is caused by the same NAT port. It happens when many sessions are created at the same time and they get the same NAT port due to the wrong port seed value.
FGR-60F-3G4G hardware switch span does not work.
Lack of null pointer check in NP6XLite driver may lead to kernel panic. Affected models: FG-40F, FG-60F, and FG-101F.
TCP 8008 permitted by authd, even though the service in the policy does not include that port.
DSL line takes a long time to synchronize.
Kernel panic on FG-101F due to lack of null pointer check on NP6XLite driver.
Kernel panic on FG-101F due to lack of null pointer check on NP6XLite driver.
Multiple ports flapping when a single interface is manually brought up. Affected platforms: FG-3810D and FG-3815D.
Unable to save configuration changes, and get failed: No space left on device error on FG-61E, FG-81E, and FG-101E.
Traffic logs reports ICMP destination as unreachable for received traffic
Legitimate traffic is unable to go through with NP6 synproxy enabled.
When changing mode from DHCP to static, the existing DHCP IP is kept so no CLI command is generated and sent to FortiManager.
Static ARP entry was removed while using DHCP relay.
High CPU usage on platforms with low free memory upon IPS engine initialization.
On FG-100F, no event is raised for PSU failure and the diagnostic command is not available.
dhcpd is not processing discover messages if they contain a 0 length option, such as 80 (rapid commit). The warning, length 0 overflows input buffer, is displayed.
FortiOS does not prompt for token when using RADIUS and two-factor authentication to connect to IPsec IKEv2.
FortiGate blocks expired root CA, even if the cross-signed intermediate CA of the root CA is valid.
gcpd has signal 11 crash at gcpd_mime_part_end.
Incomplete TCP handshake with NP offloading enabled on policies with wireless interfaces.
MAC authentication bypass is not working for some clients.
License shows expiry date of 0000-00-00.
Cannot access explicit FTP proxy via VIP.
In NGFW policy mode, sessions are not re-validated when security policies are changed.
observations.workaround: clear the session after policy change.

observations.description: When FortiAnalyzer logging is configured using an FQDN domain, the GUI displays a 500 error message on the FortiView Compromised Hosts page.
FortiView Top Traffic Shaping widget does not show data for outbound traffic if the source interface's role is WAN. Data is displayed if the source interface's role is LAN, DMZ, or undefined.
Antivirus archive logging enabled from the CLI will be disabled by editing the antivirus profile in the GUI, even if no changes are made.
Inconsistent reference count when using ports in HA session-sync-dev.
When creating an antispam block/allowlist entry, Mark as Reject should be grayed out.
Log viewer forwarded traffic does not support multiple filters for one field.
OK button missing from many pages when viewed in Chrome on an Android device.
VPN event logs are incorrectly filtered when there are two Action filters and one of them contains "-".
Warning message is not displayed when a user configures an interface with a static IP address that is already in use.

Managed FortiSwitch and FortiSwitch Ports pages are slow to load when there are many managed FortiSwitches. This performance issue needs a fix on both FortiOS and FortiSwitch. A fix was provided in FortiOS 7.0.1 GA and FortiSwitch 7.0.1 GA.
When creating or editing an IPv4 policy or address group, firewall address searching does not work if there is an empty wildcard address due to a configuration error.

GUI incorrectly displays the warning, Botnet package update unavailable, AntiVirus subscription not found., when the antivirus entitlement is expiring within 30 days. The actual botnet package update still works within the active entitlement duration.

After performing a search on firewall Addresses, the matched count over total count displayed for each address type shows an incorrect total count number. The search functionality still works correctly.
On Firewall Policy list, the tooltip for IP Pool incorrectly shows Port Block Allocation as being exhausted if there are expiring PBAs available to be reallocated.
The Edit Web Filter Profile page incorrectly shows that a URL filter is configured (even though it is not) if the URL filter entry has the same name as the web filter profile in the CLI.
When there are a lot of historical logs from FortiAnalyzer, the FortiGate GUI Forward Traffic log page can take time to load if there is no specific filter for the time range.
observations.workaround: provide a specific time range filter, or use the FortiAnalyzer GUI to view the logs.

observations.description: IPS engine 5.00027 has signal 11 crash.
IPS intelligent mode not working when reflect sessions are created on different physical interfaces.
IPS engine 5.00035 has signal 11 crash.
When IPS pcap is enabled, traffic is intermittently disrupted after disk I/O reaches IOPS limit.
User observes FGT internal error while trying to log in or activate FortiGate Cloud from the web UI.
REST API administrator with token unable to configure HA setting (via login session works).
For API user tokens with CORS enabled and set to wildcard *, direct API requests using this token are not processed properly. This issue impacts FortiOS version 5.6.1 and later.
observations.workaround: set CORS to an explicit domain.

observations.description: When CORS is enabled for REST API administrators, POST and PUT requests with body data do not work with CORS due to the pre-flight requests being handled incorrectly. This only impacts newer browser versions that use pre-flight requests.
BFD/BGP dropping when outbandwidth is set on interface.
SD-WAN local VPN traffic is not going out of the correct interface.
Slow GUI performance in large Fabric topology with over 50 downstream devices.
On IE 11, SSL VPN web portal displays blank page title {{::data.portal.heading}} after authentication.
FortiGate will intermittently stop accepting new SSL VPN connections across all VDOMs.
GUI should add support to allow using switch VLAN interface under a tenant VDOM on a managed switch VDOM.
If the firewall is downgraded from 6.2.3 to 6.2.2, the FortiLink interface loses its CAPWAP setting.
EHP drops for units with no NP service module.
FortiManager Cloud cannot be removed once the FortiGate has trouble with contract.
There is duplicate information when checking interface references in global.
SNMP does not provide routing table for non-management VDOM.
Interface emac-vlan feature does not work on SoC4 platform.
VXLAN VNI interface cannot be used with a hardware switch.
stpforward does not work with LAG interfaces on a transparent VDOM.
FortiExtender status becomes discovered after upgrading from 6.0.10 (build 0365).
observations.workaround: change the admin from discovered to enable after upgrading. config extender-controller extender edit <id> set admin enable next end
